job.style: a diary entry or letter by a student

response.passage: Dear Diary, today our teacher explained the history of the Olympics. I was surprised to learn that the ancient Games were held in Olympia, not Athens. We also discussed the Olympic rings; they represent the union of five continents, not specific countries. It is a common mistake to think the Paralympics started with the modern Games in 1896, but they actually began much later to support injured veterans. I also learned that the Paralympic Games are for athletes with various physical impairments, not just those who use wheelchairs. Many people wrongly believe that the Olympic spirit is only about winning gold, but it is actually about participating and striving for excellence. I was proud to read that India’s first individual Olympic gold medal was won by Abhinav Bindra in 2008, and that India has been winning Paralympic medals since 1972, long before the Tokyo 2020 Games. It is inspiring to see how these athletes overcome challenges to represent our nation on the global stage. I hope to learn more about the training required for these sports soon.
response.summary: The passage clarifies common misconceptions about the history and spirit of the Olympic and Paralympic Games. It highlights key facts regarding the origins of the rings, the start of the Paralympics, and India's sporting achievements.
